lines.zh: 我在半空飘着走，脚不着地。
lines.en: I drift along in the air, feet never touching.
Smaller than a block, I float light.
I drift over the grass and it doesn't bend.
My body is like a sheet of gauze.

lines.zh: 我忽左忽右，没有固定的路。
lines.en: I slip left and right with no fixed path.

lines.zh: 我往上升了一格，又落下来。
lines.en: I rise a block, then settle.
I pass between the trunks.

lines.zh: 我飘到你侧面，再飘到后面。
lines.en: I drift to your side, then behind you.

lines.zh: 我的影子没有落在地上。
lines.en: My shadow never reaches the ground.

lines.zh: 我一动，周围的空气就凉一点。
lines.en: When I move, the air around me cools.

lines.zh: 我被风吹着走，不太费劲。
lines.en: The wind carries me. It's no effort.

lines.zh: 我从灌木上飘过去，一点声音没有。
lines.en: I float over the brush without a sound.

lines.zh: 我从一片阴影里浮到另一片。
lines.en: I float from one patch of shadow to the next.

lines.zh: 我飘过水面，没留下波纹。
lines.en: I cross the water without a ripple.

lines.zh: 我随着气流往上翻了一转。
lines.en: A draught turns me over once.

lines.zh: 我在半空停了一下，改了方向。
lines.en: I pause in the air and change heading.
I hang there, almost transparent.
My edges are slowly fraying.

lines.zh: 有只虫撞到我，穿了过去。
lines.en: An insect hit me and passed through.

lines.zh: 我在看远处那些活的东西。
lines.en: I'm watching the living things far off.
In moonlight I'm clearest.
My body turns very slowly.

lines.zh: 我试着抓住一片叶子，抓不住。
lines.en: I try to hold a leaf. I can't.

lines.zh: 白天我很淡，几乎看不见。
lines.en: By day I'm faint, nearly invisible.
I float inside a tree.
I'm counting the breaths that pass.

lines.zh: 我在等一个人来看我这边。
lines.en: I wait for someone to look this way.

lines.zh: 我的形状每隔一会儿就变。
lines.en: My shape changes every little while.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛看向我，其实看不见。
lines.en: Your eyes turn to me and don't see.
One arm's length is exactly enough.
Your breath is too warm.
You carry the smell of being alive.
I'm looking at your shoulder.
I fly mid-air, out of your reach.
I don't speak. I have no mouth.

lines.zh: 你身后那团薄雾，也是我。
lines.en: That thin mist behind you is me as well.

lines.zh: 我这么淡，你为什么还看这边？
lines.en: I'm this faint. Why are you looking here?
Your heart is beating loudly.

lines.zh: 我散开一片，又慢慢合上。
lines.en: A part of me scatters and slowly closes.

lines.zh: 这一下只让我淡了一点。
lines.en: That only made me fainter.
I have no body to injure.

lines.zh: 我退到阴影里，重新聚拢。
lines.en: I retreat into the shade and regather.

lines.zh: 疼这个感觉，我记不清了。
lines.en: I can't recall what pain was like.

lines.zh: 我的边缘抖了一下，稳定下来。
lines.en: My edge trembles and steadies.

lines.zh: 你的刀穿过我，只碰到风。
lines.en: Your blade passes through me and finds only wind.
I drift half a block off and back.
That made me fainter still.

lines.zh: 我还在，只是看不太清了。
lines.en: I'm still here, just harder to see.

lines.zh: 你把东西举起来，我不需要。
lines.en: You hold it up. I don't need it.
That living warmth smells better than food.

lines.zh: 你指尖的味道，我够得着。
lines.en: The scent on your fingertip is within reach.
That drop of honey, I can only lick once.
It passes through my hand.

lines.zh: 你手里的热气，我感觉得到。
lines.en: I can feel the heat from your hand.
I don't want food. I want cold.
What you set down, I ignore.
That bait means nothing to me.
I'm drifting closer. Don't move.
You passed through me and went cold.
I have no body to collide with.

lines.zh: 你的手在我身体里，没有触感。
lines.en: Your hand is inside me and feels nothing.

lines.zh: 这一下我散开，又聚回来。
lines.en: That scattered me; I gathered again.
You shuddered. That was me.
I drift half a circle at your side.

lines.zh: 你的头发被我的气吹动了。
lines.en: Your hair stirred in my passing.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀擦过你的耳朵。
lines.en: My wings brush your ear.

lines.zh: 我贴在你背后，没有温度。
lines.en: I'm at your back with no warmth.
You retreat, and I retreat with you.
I don't have that sort of thing anymore.
Reach for me and you'll pass through.
This body is only a shadow.
I prefer drifting, unmoving.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气，我受不了。
lines.en: Your warmth is more than I can bear.
The night is short. Don't waste it.
I have no weight to lean on.
That's for the living.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我受不住热气。
lines.en: Not this close. I can't take the warmth.
I only want to drift quietly.

lines.zh: 我的手穿过去了，什么也没拿到。
lines.en: My hand passes through and takes nothing.

lines.zh: 我试着把东西托起来，托不住。
lines.en: I try to lift it. It won't stay.
I draw a little of the heat from it.

lines.zh: 东西在我身子里沉下去了。
lines.en: It sinks through me.
I float a circle around it.
I only look. I don't take.
This cold thing. I like it.
I touch it and it goes cold.

lines.zh: 我把它拨到一边，用气流。
lines.en: I nudge it aside with a draught.
Leave that for someone else.
You've walked into this shadow.

lines.zh: 我一直在你旁边，你没察觉。
lines.en: I've been beside you the whole time.

lines.zh: 我的形比刚才清楚了一点。
lines.en: I'm a little clearer now.

lines.zh: 你身上的活着的气太重。
lines.en: The living smell on you is too strong.
I slowly gather toward you.

lines.zh: 这里的空气变冷了，你感觉到了。
lines.en: The air's gone cold. You felt it.
I circle you, waiting for your hand.
I hover just above the back of your neck.
There are no lamps in this room.
I float inside your shadow.

lines.zh: 我的边缘贴到你的肩上了。
lines.en: My edge is touching your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你听，什么声音都没有了。
lines.en: Listen. There's no sound at all now.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，你察觉不到。
lines.en: I follow you and you can't tell.
When you stop, I'm at your back.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在空气里留痕。
lines.en: Your breath leaves a trace in the air.

lines.zh: 我飘得比你走得快一点。
lines.en: I drift a little faster than you walk.
Wherever you turn, I'm at your back-left.

lines.zh: 我不需要路，我可以穿墙。
lines.en: I need no path. I pass through walls.
Your heartbeat grows clearer.
I wait in the doorway for you to come back.
The temperature keeps dropping here.
You look up and there's nothing.

lines.zh: 我把门口的光挡掉了一半。
lines.en: I've blocked half the light at the door.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙飘，墙那边也是我。
lines.en: I drift along the wall. The far side is me too.
I pass through your chest.
No sound. Only a patch of cold.
My hand stops at the side of your neck.

lines.zh: 你浑身的毛都立起来了。
lines.en: Every hair on you stands up.

lines.zh: 我从背后抱住你，没有重量。
lines.en: I hold you from behind with no weight.
That made you flinch.
I press to your face and you shut your eyes.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸被我抽走一点。
lines.en: I draw a little of your breath away.

lines.zh: 我从你身体里穿出来，很慢。
lines.en: I come out through your body. Slowly.
You back away and I gather again.

lines.zh: 我从墙角的暗处聚起来。
lines.en: I gather out of the dark corner.
The lamp in this room suddenly dimmed.

lines.zh: 我先是雾，慢慢有了形状。
lines.en: First mist, then slowly a shape.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀从缝隙里展开。
lines.en: My wings unfold from the gap.
I come out of the mirror.
I float between two beds.
At three in the morning I'm clearest.
When the lamp goes out, I fly closer.
Part of this darkness is me.

lines.zh: 门没有开，我已经在屋里。
lines.en: The door didn't open, and I'm inside.

lines.zh: 火光靠近，我整个往后退。
lines.en: The flame nears and I draw back entirely.
I have no weight, so I fall slowly.
Water passes through me; I scatter and return.

lines.zh: 气浪把我撕成几片，慢慢回来。
lines.en: The blast tears me into pieces that drift back.

lines.zh: 东西穿过去，只带走一点薄雾。
lines.en: It passes through, taking a wisp of me.

lines.zh: 那股力抓住了我，这是头一回。
lines.en: That force caught me. A first.

lines.zh: 我越来越淡，快要看不见了。
lines.en: I'm fading, nearly out of sight.

lines.zh: 雷光一亮，我整片都白了。
lines.en: The lightning flashes and I go white.
I drift down along with the dark.
